Package org.frc5411.lib.pattern

Interface Component<Measurement extends edu.wpi.first.util.struct.StructSerializable>

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable, Closeable, edu.wpi.first.util.sendable.Sendable
All Known Subinterfaces:
Actuator<Reference,Measurement>, Controller<States,Inputs,Outputs>
All Known Implementing Classes:
Camera, Gyroscope, LimelightCamera, MockCamera, MockModule, Module, PIDController, PigeonGyroscope, ProfiledPIDController, SparkModule
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface Component<@NonNull Measurement extends edu.wpi.first.util.struct.StructSerializable> extends Closeable, edu.wpi.first.util.sendable.Sendable

Component

Describes any given mechanical system that one, can periodically produce a measurement, and two, can periodically produce a report object, which contains the latest measurement, and all the measurements that have occurred between calls to periodic,and lastly, close held resources, such as motor controllers or encoders. This provides a base implementation of essentially any mechanical system that involves electrical components that produce values.

    • configure

      default void configure()
      Force re-configures the underlying hardware to the standard specifications of this type. Ideally, a blocking operation is also performed which ensures correct, hardware-safe application of relevant configurations before periodic operation.

    • reset

      default void reset()
      Force resets this Component's states and hardware, may fix issues. Should ideally not be called repeatedly or often such as during periodic().

    • periodic

      default void periodic()
      Performs any necessary logic that this device may need with each update, such as maintaining the position of itself using a controller, or updating relevant internal values.

    • close

      default void close() throws IOException
      Closes this instance immediately and performs locking-operations to ensure the complete closure of all hardware references. This renders any references to this instance unusable, and should essentially only be done when robot-code has finished operations.
